limitations: Byte consistency and retained provenance only; not machine code, integration, signal safety or custody proof.
No command/capture/test replay; the reviewed packet is a bounded corpus, not proof of all external operations.
Exact public projection excludes command paths and raw source payloads; no general secret-discovery claim.

limits: No production implementation, compiler or runtime result is added by this review.
Lexical index includes comments/declarations and is not a compiler-resolved call graph or whole-program absence proof.
Conditional source schedules are not observed faults or demonstrated exploitation.
New common inline boundary excludes vtable/raw writers and azstem; no universal exclusion.
SDK inline claimant association does not establish replacement-code or raw original-slot lifetime/aliasing.
Loader constructors precede module publication; other mutable g_cm users and arbitrary loader behavior remain outside new immutable records.
Makefile recipe/probe text is not executed-build, loaded-binary, Linux atomic codegen or ABI evidence.
Signal/nonlocal exits, loader/interposition dependencies, native/cache publication, races/lifetime, persistence, quiescence and recovery remain unproved.
Ownership is not fault causation; quarantine and all native activation/writer/topology/stopped-recovery gates remain.
new_source_findings: Static header protection locks are distinct across separate azmod and azstem C builds.
Community-only prechecks and post-unlock nhooks update do not serialize init closure with admitted claims.
Conditional dlinfo failure leaves zero scratch base and can match a zero-based enumerated object without intended DSO provenance; not observed.
Current g_cm count precedes record initialization and range scratch fields are separately mutated.
Actual relocation word count and allocation/protection outcomes must be captured within installer, not reconstructed from return code/orig.
Successful protection restoration can preserve earlier writable bits; disjoint emitted blobs do not imply separate pages.

proposed_protocol.boundary: azmod inline installer only, not process-wide exclusion
proposed_protocol.emission: Actual relocation out/ncopy, retained pool/slot/mapping and separate returned protection/cleanup receipts; final prevalidation before target unlock
proposed_protocol.init_admission: Capture caller RA at outer SDK entry; revalidate under common discipline; close epoch and finish bookkeeping under same discipline; no new thread predicate
proposed_protocol.lock_order: g_cm_mu -> common inline writer -> azmod translation-unit protection lock; Core uses writer -> protection and never writer -> g_cm_mu
proposed_protocol.lookup: Module first per PC/LR/frame; generated Community PC may beat module LR; typed Core continues fallback; later module masking remains
proposed_protocol.module_publication: Explicit successful handle/base provenance, checked private scratch, fixed16 immutable per-index commit flags; publish before entry/descriptor check and retain after failure
proposed_protocol.phase: Serialize go_late with complete fallback install; not native quiescence
proposed_protocol.publication: Infallible bounded metadata visibility before permanent original and redirect; no post-unlock fallible provider or lock
proposed_protocol.retention: Published owner/code/original custody permanent; invisible uncertain cleanup custody retained independently

scope: Source-only azmod inline writer/admission, owned emission and immutable module-input integration review
